hero.desc: Dance and movement as tools for expression and well-being. Art as a path to social transformation.

seq1.p1: There are places that do not exist on the map.

seq2.p1: is a social organization born to build these places. Spaces where dance is not only performance, but above all is presence. Where movement is more than exercise or stretching, it is listening and expression. Where art is not an end, but the beginning of an encounter.
seq2.p2: The encounter with oneself and the connection that happens when people breathe and move in the same rhythm.
seq2.p3: Change begins from within, when a person rediscovers their own strength, their creativity, their own voice. And when this happens in a group, a path opens up for
seq2.p6: creates the conditions for people to meet.

card1.desc: Every body holds a dance it hasn't yet dared to release. These workshops are a space where movement, presence, and expression bring it to light.

card2.desc: Conscious movement practices that expand perception, encourage bodily reorganization, and transform how we inhabit our bodies.

card3.desc: Community projects that reach across streets and neighborhoods - weaving connections, building bonds, and sparking transformation.

1.title: Expression
1.desc: The body holds what words cannot express. In the workshops, movement becomes a language and creates a space where rhythm, presence and improvisation set free what has been held back.

2.title: Well-being
2.desc: Listening to the body is a political act. Conscious movement practices expand perception, reorganize physical patterns and give people back agency over themselves.

3.title: Creation
3.desc: Movement is raw material. From dance, choreography is born; from silence, a gesture is born; from the encounter, art is born. Art is what happens when the body has the freedom to express itself.

4.title: Transformation
4.desc: When people move together, something changes. Dance crosses walls, creates bonds and opens space for a transformation that begins in the body and reverberates in the streets, throughout the neighborhood, and across the city.

action.desc: Find a workshop, a class, your place. The body knows the way, just start.
action.btn2: I want to support the project

footer.desc: Transforming lives through movement and dance. A project focused on expression and social well-being.

hero.subtitle: A model for universal access to culture and movement. Premium workshops, free for residents of Tøyen and Grønland - sustained by multiple funding sources.

context.title: Why Tøyen and Grønland?
context.p1: Tøyen and Grønland are neighbourhoods of contrast - diversity, history and cultural richness coexist with inequalities in access to quality services and activities. This is exactly the context that calls us to act.
context.p2: Dance2Dance was founded in this neighborhood with a clear mission: that dance, movement and well-being should not be a privilege for those who can pay. Every workshop we develop carries the same quality, the same care and the same intention - regardless of who is in the room.
context.quote: The same product. The same quality. The same value. For everyone.

value.kicker: The value of what we offer
value.title: Free does not mean without value.
value.subtitle: Those who receive it for free receive exactly the same as those who pay. We make the real price visible because perceived value matters - for supporters and participants alike.

paid.label: External participants
paid.desc: Residents from outside Tøyen and Grønland participate at the regular rate, with access to the same premium quality experience.

free.label: Tøyen and Grønland residents
free.desc: Local residents have guaranteed, free access to all workshops. No waiting lists, no distinction, no lesser quality.

value.insight: “Free access with price transparency creates dignity. The person is not receiving charity - they are receiving the opportunity to be part of something with real value.”

model.title: An ecosystem of support.
model.intro: Dance2Dance was designed not to rely on a single source. Our sustainability comes from the strategic combination of multiple pillars - each essential, none sufficient alone.

pillar1.title: Paying participants
pillar1.desc: Those who come from outside Tøyen and Grønland pay the real value of the workshop. This revenue directly contributes to enabling free access for local residents.

pillar2.title: Companies & sponsors
pillar2.desc: Private companies wishing to associate their brand with real social impact and quality culture will find a purposeful and visible partner in Dance2Dance.

pillar3.title: Public funds & municipality
pillar3.desc: The project aligns with public policies on cultural and community inclusion, making it eligible for support from cultural funds and the City of Oslo.

pillar4.title: Individual donors
pillar4.desc: People who believe in the power of art as social transformation can support directly, becoming part of the story from the very beginning.

model.summary: The diversification of revenue sources is intentional: it ensures the project does not depend on any single entity, making it more resilient and scalable over time.

partners.title: Partners who build with us.
partners.desc: Dance2Dance does not act alone. We work in network with organisations that share the conviction that art transforms and that access to culture is a right.

cta.title: Support what is still being born.
cta.desc: Funds, companies and partners who arrive now are part of the foundation - and the story - of this project. Get in touch and discover how to be part of it.
cta.btn1: I want to be a partner

hero.subtitle: Culture doesn't have to be a privilege. With the methodology of Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, we bring world-class workshops to Tøyen and Grønland residents through a plural, secure, and sustainable financing model.

context.title: The art of democratizing excellence.
context.p1: Tøyen and Grønland breathe diversity, but also face visible barriers to accessing culture. Where many see a challenge, we see the perfect ground to plant a new model of social integration.
context.p2: Backed by the technical expertise of Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, Dance2Dance offers an aesthetic and transformative experience. Knowledge and practices developed over years of artistic experience now reach the local community through dance workshops, body awareness practices, and social integration experiences.
context.quote: Excellence is not a privilege. It is an opportunity.

value.title: Perceived value. Real impact.
value.subtitle: Our free spots are not charity, they are full scholarships funded by our ecosystem. By pricing the workshop for external audiences, we prove the high value delivered to local residents and our investors.

paid.label: Paying Audience
paid.desc: Regular students attest to the quality of the service and inject revenue that fuels the social impact.

free.label: Local Community
free.desc: Residents receive unrestricted access to the same infrastructure and teachers, generating dignity and belonging.

value.insight: “Social projects that do not compromise on the highest standards of technical quality attract partners who demand excellence in their own brands.”

pillar1.title: Self Revenue

pillar2.title: Visionary Brands
pillar2.desc: Corporate sponsors who add the project to their ESG impact reports, gaining visibility and social capital.

pillar3.title: Public Funding
pillar3.desc: Strategic alignment with public policies and cultural grants from the Norwegian government, validating institutional rigor.

pillar4.title: Private Donors
pillar4.desc: Independent philanthropists who demand clear metrics and believe in the transformative power of somatic practices and access to culture.

model.summary: An antifragile model: if one source fluctuates, the financial matrix rebalances itself. Maximum security for investors, guaranteed continuity for dancers.

partners.title: Partners who build together.
partners.desc: Dance2Dance does not act alone. We work in a network with organizations that share the conviction that art transforms and that access to culture is a right.

cta.title: Associate your brand with transformation.

projects.title: Our target. Our mission.

youth.title: Be the Dance Ung
youth.subtitle: Low-threshold dance, mastery, and inclusion
youth.desc: An authentic low-threshold access space for youth in Tøyen and Grønland. Led by Safia, we use dance to create a space of belonging. The goal goes beyond inclusion: we aim to qualify these youth through technical mastery and shape the next generation of dancers.

women.title: Dance2Dance Kvinne
women.subtitle: Social meeting place, wellbeing, and confidence
women.desc: Integrating our Biostretch and Be the Dance methodologies, we offer a dedicated space for women. By uniting conscious movement and artistic expression, we promote not only preventive quality of life but also personal wellbeing, self-knowledge, and confidence, creating a vital meeting point against social isolation.

be-the-dance.title: Be the Dance
be-the-dance.subtitle: Discover the dance that exists within you.
be-the-dance.description: Philosophy and concept of Be the Dance...

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE
content: is a program consisting of four dance workshops.
It was designed for you to explore movement as a path to presence, expression, and self-discovery, awakening something essential and unique that already exists within you: your very own dance.

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE IS FOR EVERYONE
content: Dance can be born in the body of anyone who allows themselves to move.
There are no prerequisites.
You just need to feel and allow the movement to express itself.
At any age or physical condition, it is possible to discover your own way of dancing.

philosophy.title: WHERE IS THE DANCE?
content: It is not restricted to a technique, a predefined style, or a special talent.
It exists in everyone, as an inherent creativity ready to take shape through the body.

philosophy.title: HOW DOES DANCE HAPPEN?
content: Dance has accompanied us for millennia, as ritual, celebration, and artistic expression. Even if you don't remember, there is a memory of movement in the body, an ability to feel, create, and dance.
By creating a sensitive dialogue between music and body, we open up the possibility of exploring new paths of movement. Going beyond the known allows new forms of expression to emerge.
Dance happens beyond control and the search for an ideal form. When we allow ourselves to be present, a more authentic and unique expression can emerge from the body.

philosophy.title: WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS?
content: • Promotes deep relaxation and contributes to stress reduction.
• Increases energy, physical responsiveness, and the fluidity of movements.
• Recognizes natural movements and expands body awareness, creating space for a more authentic expression.
• Develops attention, awakening the senses and deepening presence.
• Explores the relationship between breath and movement, discovering new ways to dance with more freedom.
• Expands perception by recognizing the different parts of the body and the relationships between them.

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE
content: Workshops that integrate movement awareness with dance and meditation practices, so you can discover and express the dance that already exists within you.

be-water.title: Be Water
be-water.fullDescription:
Surrendering to movement is finding the flow.
When we stop trying to direct every gesture, the body naturally finds new paths. Movement becomes freer and more organic, guided by listening and sensation.
In this workshop, we explore flowing as a possibility of expression. An invitation to experience movement without resistance, trust the body, and allow one action to naturally lead to the next.
Like water, which finds its way without needing to fight against it, we learn to follow the movement instead of controlling it.
Be Water is an experience of surrender. A space to let the body follow its own flow and discover the dance that emerges when we simply let go.
be-water.closingQuote: Be Water, My Friend. Empty your mind. Be formless, shapeless, like water. You put water into a cup, it becomes the cup. You put water into a bottle, it becomes the bottle. You put it into a teapot, it becomes the teapot. Now water can flow or it can crash. Be water, my friend.

be-balance.title: Be Balance
be-balance.fullDescription:
Finding balance is learning to listen to the body.
Balance is not static. It is in constant movement, between support and impulse, stability and change, presence and action.
In this workshop, we explore this dynamic relationship and the different ways to find stability within movement. An invitation to discover how strength, lightness, and balance can coexist and create new possibilities.
The body has its own intelligence. When we learn to listen to it, we can trust its choices and allow it to find its own balance.
be-balance.closingQuote: Balance is not the absence of movement, but the perfect harmony between the forces that move us.

be-total.title: Be Total
be-total.fullDescription:
To dance is to be whole. It is holding nothing back.
Without protecting yourself, without hesitating, without saving energy. When we allow ourselves to be fully in what we do, the body finds the freedom to express itself with spontaneity and truth.
In this workshop, we explore total surrender to the moment. An invitation to trust the impulse, commit fully to each gesture, and let the body express itself without reservation.
It is not about doing more, but about being completely present in what we do. About putting everything into the movement and allowing each gesture to be lived entirely.
Be Total is an experience of surrender and expression. A space to be totally present, without saving energy, and discover what happens when we allow ourselves to dance without reservation.
be-total.closingQuote: DANCE, my heart. Dance today with joy.

be-stillness.title: Be Stillness
be-stillness.fullDescription:
In stillness, the body begins to speak.
Between one thought and another, between one breath and the next, there is silence. It is in this gap that we can listen to the subtlest sensations of the body.
In this workshop, we explore pausing and listening as an essential part of movement. An invitation to slow down and feel the body, letting what is revealed emerge when there is no need to always be in motion.
Stillness is not the absence of movement. It is above all possibility.
Be Stillness is an experience of listening. A space to be present, find silence within movement, and allow the dance to reveal itself from there.

be-the-dance-pro.title: Be the Dance Pro
be-the-dance-pro.fullDescription:
You are already a dancer. Now, be the dance.

Technique is the instrument through which the dancer expresses their art. But there is something beyond it: a presence, a quality of surrender, a way of being in the movement that makes some dancers capable of capturing our attention and touching us in a unique way.
What is presence?

In this workshop, we investigate this “something more”. An invitation to go beyond execution, the intellect, and the mind that observes and controls, and dive into an experience of presence, awareness, and surrender.

Through practices of somatic education, meditation, guided improvisation, and other tools for movement exploration, we create space to listen to the body, expand perception, and discover new possibilities of being on stage.

More than adding new tools to technique, Be the Dance Pro proposes a journey inward. An investigation into what happens when we stop merely doing the dance and allow it to happen through us.
What is charisma?

​
Be the Dance Pro is an experience of presence and totality. A space to deepen the relationship between body, mind, and movement and discover what makes each dancer unique. A quest to lose oneself in the dance to find that place where dancer and dance cease to be two different things.

The moment the dancer is the dance itself.

be-the-dance-day.title: Be the Dance Day
be-the-dance-day.fullDescription:
Dancing is also encountering the other.

There is music that makes us travel, rhythms that awaken the body, and movements that bring us closer, even when we don't speak the same language.

Be the Dance Day is an open gathering for everyone to dance, have fun, and share the experience of movement to the sounds of different music and cultures.

Throughout the gathering, we are invited to experience different rhythms, ways of dancing, and ways of relating to music and those around us. No dance experience is necessary, no right or wrong steps, just the curiosity to experiment and the freedom to let ourselves go.

More than learning a dance, it is an opportunity to experience dance as an encounter: with music, with the body, with different cultures, and with other people.

​
Be the Dance Day is a celebration of movement and diversity. A space to let the body loose, discover new rhythms, have fun, create connections, and simply dance.

Come as you are. Let's dance together.

origin.title: The Origin of Be The Dance
paragraphs: My history with dance started early. At seven years old, between barres, mirrors, precise positions, and rigorous discipline, I entered a ballet school. It was a universe of rules, codified movements, repetition, and demands. The body had to obey. The search for the perfect movement.
[SILVER]And yet, I fell in love.

Dance took me far. As a classical ballerina, I traveled to different parts of the world to refine my technique, draw inspiration from various traditions, and get closer to that idea of perfection that ballet teaches us to pursue.
But, at some point, something began to change. My body was tired. And inside me, a growing desire to express dance in other ways was born. That was when I found modern dance.

There, other doors opened. I discovered freer, more natural, and organic movements. I discovered that the body could also create, improvise, investigate. That an emotion could transform a gesture. That not every movement needed to be beautiful, precise, correct, or planned. And I began to realize that perhaps dance could be much more than technique.

Throughout this journey, one phrase kept coming up repeatedly: “I would love to dance… but I don't want to be a dancer.” People who didn't want to go on stage or audition. Who didn't want to spend years inside a dance school. People who simply felt the urge to dance, but believed dance belonged to a place they had no access to.
[SILVER]That stayed with me.

Years later, when I was already directing my own dance company, I created, along with choreographer Mark Sieczkarek, an event in a park, open to everyone. And then something very simple and, at the same time, transformative happened.
[GOLD]People started to dance.
People who might never have imagined doing so in public were there, moving their bodies, meeting others, laughing, playing, experimenting. Dance stepped off the stage and came alive.

It was there that I understood, in a very concrete way, how much dance can bring people together, create encounters, and awaken joy. It didn't need to be confined to a classroom, a company, or a stage. Dance could happen anywhere there was a body willing to move.
Then the pandemic came. The world stopped. Doors closed. We were isolated in our homes, separated from each other, and, in a way, from our own bodies.
It was in this silence that Be The Dance began to emerge. The inspiration came from a documentary about Bruce Lee and an idea that struck me: Be Water.
[SILVER]To be water. To move. To adapt. To flow. To find paths.

And I thought: what if we could do the same with dance? Thus the idea of a series of workshops for people who are not dancers was born. Not to teach steps. Not to prepare anyone for a stage. Not to turn anyone into a professional. But to dance, play, explore, and discover.
[GOLD]To discover what moves us. To discover how we move.
To discover what happens when we stop trying to control the body and start listening to it. And above all, to discover where the dance is in each of us.

Because I believe dance is not a privilege of those born flexible, those who started at age four, or those who learned to count in eights. Dance is in our genes. It is in the impulse to sway when we hear music. In the body that moves when we are happy. In the spontaneous gesture. In the breath. In the rhythm. In the desire to celebrate, to seduce, to play, and to be free. Perhaps we all have the dance inside us and it just needs a spark to emerge.

By that time, I had been practicing meditation for a few years, and my relationship with dance had profoundly transformed. Aesthetics and technique still had their place, but they were no longer enough.
[SILVER]I began to see the body as a vessel.

A place of listening. A landscape of discovery. An instrument through which we can push past our own boundaries and find a form of expression that is unique, personal, and genuine. That is how Be The Dance began to take shape.

But I soon realized that this investigation could also be profoundly transformative for professional dancers. Because I know this journey intimately. I know how a dancer can dedicate years to perfecting their technique. The correct position. The highest jump. The perfect line. Absolute control of the body.

But who teaches us to be present? Who teaches us to find our own movement within a choreography? Who talks about charisma, presence, authenticity? Who shows us ways to know the body beyond its appearance? Who helps us discover who we are when we dance?
Be The Dance is born precisely from this place. Between technique and freedom, body and emotion, movement and presence. Between what we learn and what already exists inside us.
It is an invitation to experiment and let the body think, feel, and speak. For the dancer who wishes to go beyond technique. And for those who always believed they “can't dance”.
Because maybe you don't need to know how. Maybe you just need to start. And then discover that the dance was already there. Waiting for you.

[GOLD]Be The Dance. Don't just dance.
Be the dance.
[SIGNATURE]Safia

biostretch.title: Biostretch
biostretch.subtitle: Four decades of research into movement.

philosophy.title: WHAT IS BIOSTRETCH?
content: Biostretch is an exercise system that promotes reconnection with the body through movement awareness.

The method uses attention as its main tool: a simple, powerful resource accessible to everyone. By directing it to the experience of movement, we expand the perception of the body and open space for new possibilities of bodily organization.

Inspired by more than four decades of studies in dance, Somatic Education, and meditation, the method recognizes the body as an intelligent, integrated system in constant transformation. Instead of seeking performance or correction, it proposes a subtle investigation of the bodily experience, where what is done matters less than how it is done.
It is from this experience of presence that a new way of perceiving and inhabiting the body emerges. But how does this transformation happen in practice?

philosophy.title: HOW DOES IT WORK?
content: The practice of Biostretch invites you to slow down, relax your body, and direct your attention to simple movements and the sensations they awaken.

In this exploration, it becomes possible to recognize tension patterns, movement habits, and forms of bodily organization that usually remain outside our perception because they operate automatically and unconsciously. The apparent simplicity of the practice reveals a profound work of listening, perception, and reorganization.

When performed slowly, gently, and effortlessly, the exercises promote a state of balance in the nervous system, responsible for coordinating communication between body and mind and regulating bodily functions. In this state, the body finds space to release tension, reorganize itself, and recover the natural fluidity of movement.

More than teaching new movements, Biostretch strengthens trust in the body's innate intelligence and invites you to rediscover the pleasure of moving with freedom, presence, and awareness. The best part is that this experience is within anyone's reach.

philosophy.title: WHO CAN PRACTICE?
content: Biostretch can be practiced by people of all ages and different levels of experience, physical conditioning, or mobility.

The practice respects the individuality of each body. There is no ideal movement to be achieved, nor an external standard to be followed. Each person explores the sequences within their own limits and possibilities, at their own pace.

Instead of adapting the body to a model, Biostretch values what each person already has: their ability to perceive, learn, and find more comfortable and functional paths for movement. Thus, the practice strengthens autonomy, confidence, and the pleasure of inhabiting one's own body.
And what can this practice transform in daily life?

philosophy.title: WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS?
content: Regular practice of Biostretch helps to relieve tension, increase mobility, improve posture, and make movements lighter, coordinated, and comfortable. Over time, the body recovers fluidity and efficiency, making daily activities easier and more pleasant.

By promoting balance in the nervous system, the practice also helps reduce the effects of stress, improve breathing quality, and relieve pain and discomfort associated with muscle tension, especially in areas like the neck, shoulders, and back. Additionally, it contributes to preventing injuries related to repetitive patterns and overuse of the body.
Over time, these changes extend beyond the practice and become part of how we move, perceive, and use our bodies in everyday life.

uma-melhor-postura.title: A Better Posture
uma-melhor-postura.shortDescription: What if you could improve your posture without trying to "fix" your body? Experience a new relationship with your body, with more support, freedom, and ease to move.
uma-melhor-postura.fullDescription:
Your posture tells a story. It reflects the way you organize your body, the habits you've developed over a lifetime, and how you relate to the environment around you.
More than a position we must hold, posture is a dynamic organization of the body to move, balance, and meet the world. It is present in everything we do and influences our sense of comfort, freedom of movement, support, and well-being.
Our skeleton and musculature have an incredible capacity to support us against gravity while allowing for movement and adaptation. However, over time, we can develop habits that increase the effort needed to stay upright, generating unnecessary tensions and pain.
In the A Better Posture workshop, we will explore simple and gentle movements that help recognize these habits and release accumulated tensions.
As the body discovers new ways to organize itself, it finds more efficient and comfortable support. A better posture emerges naturally, without effort or rigidity, allowing you to move with more freedom and ease.
Less effort to stay upright. More comfort and freedom to move.

aprendendo-a-relaxar.title: Learning to Relax
aprendendo-a-relaxar.shortDescription: What if relaxing wasn't something you have to do? Discover how to release unnecessary tension and create space for more calm and presence.
aprendendo-a-relaxar.fullDescription:
Being relaxed is our natural state. Therefore, relaxing is not something we can do, but rather something we can let happen by releasing tension and effort that are no longer necessary.
When the body feels safe and comfortable, relaxation happens naturally, and we can better perceive our breathing, our movements, and the habits that influence how we relate to our own body.
​
In the Learning to Relax workshop, through gentle, effortless movements connected with the breath, we will create the conditions for the body to slow down and the nervous system to find a state of greater calm and restoration.
Relaxation then becomes much more than a pause. It can be a path to expand awareness, perceive what is happening inside us, and discover new possibilities of being in the world.
More calm on the inside. More presence, confidence, and freedom to meet the outside world.

alongar-respirar-e-meditar.title: Stretch, Breathe and Meditate
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.shortDescription: What happens when the body and mind simply stop? Let's prepare the body together, find the breath, and explore a path to meditation.
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.fullDescription:
We are almost always busy with something. But being busy does not necessarily mean being present.
Our body and mind have grown accustomed to movement, action, and constant stimuli. Therefore, simply sitting, being quiet, and being present can be a challenge.
Let's first create conditions for the body to find comfort and stillness.
In the Stretch, Breathe, and Meditate workshop, we will explore gentle movements to release joints and unnecessary tension. We will seek points of support that allow us to sit with more comfort and stability, keeping the spine upright without rigidity.
The breath will be our anchor as the body and mind slow down. Without forcing. Without trying to reach beyond what the body allows, just noticing how the body is in the moment.
Without needing to achieve anything. Without needing to do anything. Just creating space for meditation to happen.

transformando-habitos.title: Transforming Habits
transformando-habitos.shortDescription: Do you choose how you move, or do your habits choose for you? Recognize your movement patterns and discover new possibilities to move with more freedom, comfort, and ease.
transformando-habitos.fullDescription:
Much of what we do every day happens automatically. These are habits and movement patterns we've learned throughout life that influence our posture, how we move, and even how we feel.
Habits are important. With them, it is possible to perform tasks without having to relearn how to do them every time. But some patterns that were once useful can over time become limiting, creating tension, discomfort, and unnecessary effort.
In the Transforming Habits workshop, we will recognize these patterns and experience new movement possibilities. By expanding our perception, new paths of movement emerge that were previously unused.
A habit does not simply need to be eliminated. We can transform it, offering the body new options and allowing it to discover easier, more pleasurable, and more efficient ways to move.
More perception. More possibilities. More freedom to choose how to move.

movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.title: Daily Movements to Prevent Stress
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.shortDescription: What if a few minutes of movement could change the way you go through your day? Learn simple movements to release tension, regain balance, and slow down.
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.fullDescription:
Stress is our body's natural response to situations that require adaptation.
The way our body responds to stress and returns to a state of balance influences our well-being. We can remain for long periods accumulating tension and effort without realizing it. Over time, this can affect our energy, concentration, our sleep, the ability to relax, and our quality of life.
In the Daily Movements to Prevent Stress workshop, we will explore movements that help perceive and release accumulated tension and direct attention to areas of the body we tend to hold tight.
More than just relaxing for a few moments, we will learn simple movements and strategies that can be incorporated into daily life, creating small pauses to interrupt the accumulation of tension and regain balance.
Learning to perceive stress in the body is the first step to learning to respond to it in a different way.

recuperando-o-foco.title: Regaining Focus
recuperando-o-foco.shortDescription: What if regaining focus started with emptying the mind? Discover how relaxation and attention to the body can restore your ability to concentrate.
recuperando-o-foco.fullDescription:
Our focus is being stolen. Notifications, social media, emails, multitasking. We live under a constant avalanche of information that fragments our attention and pulls us away from the present moment.
Faced with this, it is natural to try to regain concentration with more effort: more discipline, more control, more willpower. But the mind is already overwhelmed. Demanding more of it is like trying to empty a full glass by pouring more into it.
The path is the opposite.
To regain the ability to focus, we must first empty ourselves. Release the accumulation of tension, stimuli, and noise that the body and mind carry without realizing it.
In the Regaining Focus workshop, we will use gentle, effortless movements to create an internal space of silence and safety. By directing attention to the body and breath, we allow the nervous system to slow down and the mind to naturally find a state of greater clarity.
It's not about training concentration. It's about creating the conditions for it to restore itself. When the body relaxes and the mind empties, focus re-emerges as a consequence of a state of presence.
Regaining focus is, above all, regaining stillness.

regularClasses.title: Regular Classes
regularClasses.description: Continuous in-person practice to maintain well-being.

origin.title: The Origin of Biostretch
paragraphs: It all started in New York.

I was looking for new ways to express dance. I wanted to go beyond what I already knew, to cross the borders of the body I had learned to master. And that's how I arrived in the Big Apple. I went to study modern dance, specifically an approach called Release Technique.
[SILVER]And then, everything I knew about dance began to crumble.

I came from classical ballet, a universe of precise forms, codified movements, carefully constructed lines, muscles trained to obey. In Release, it was almost the opposite. Movement didn't need to be imposed on the body. It could be born within it.

A small impulse, a shift in weight, a breath, a relationship with gravity, and something would begin to move. The body seemed to find its own paths. The skeleton, our most basic and profound structure, became the starting point for endless possibilities.
It was difficult. And deeply thought-provoking.

My body was still trapped in ballet. It took me months just to be able to release my stomach. To breathe more naturally. To allow the body to stop being permanently prepared to execute and simply begin to feel. It was a deconstruction.
[GOLD]A dive into the unknown.
It was during this period that I was introduced to different methods of Somatic Education. I fell in love immediately.

I began seeking out these practices everywhere, in every class I could find. And little by little, I started to realize something that would forever change my relationship with movement: maybe the body didn't need more effort. Maybe it needed more listening.

These practices, usually gentle with the body, start from a powerful idea: there is an inherent bodily intelligence within us. And when we learn to listen to it, when we develop movement awareness, we open paths to more health, freedom, and presence.

First, I realized how essential this was for dancers. Then, I realized it was essential for everyone. For those who spend hours in front of a computer. For those who work standing up. For those who practice sports. For those who feel pain, tension, or limitations. For those who simply wish to know their own body better and discover a freer way to move through life.
[SILVER]But there was yet another discovery.

The more I practiced, the more I realized that this work wasn't just about the body. It challenged some of the pillars upon which we build modern life: effort, competence, productivity, efficiency, and control. We live in a culture that teaches us to do more, faster, better. To control. To overcome. To conquer.

What if, for a few moments, we did the opposite? What if, instead of demanding a response from the body, we learned to listen to it? What if, instead of seeking the perfection of movement, we investigated the experience of being in motion?

For me, this practice became a kind of moving meditation. A space of encountering oneself. A moment to suspend, for an instant, everything we learned about how a body should be, how it should move, how it should function. And to begin an investigation. Not to arrive at a right movement. But to discover what is possible.
It was then I realized I could bring together three worlds that had crossed my life: dance, meditative practice, and Somatic Education. From this intersection, Biostretch was born. A living method.
[SILVER]Living because it doesn't end when the practice ends.

What we perceive during a session can cross the room's door and accompany us into life. It can transform the way we walk, sit, breathe, work, dance, rest. It can bring more comfort, ease, and efficiency to the simplest movements, precisely those we repeat every day without even noticing.
[GOLD]In Biostretch, awareness is key.

Because it's not just the movement we make that matters. It's the quality with which it happens. It's what happens before the movement. It's what we perceive while it happens. It's what changes when we stop fighting against the body and start conversing with it.

Perhaps you've spent your entire life trying to make your body obey.
What if now was the moment to listen to it? That is the investigation I propose in Biostretch classes. An invitation to slow down, to feel, to breathe. To release what no longer needs to be held. To discover paths that were there all along, just waiting for you to pay attention.
Come and try it. Perhaps you won't just discover a new way to move.
[GOLD]Perhaps you will discover a new way to be in your own body.
[SIGNATURE]Safia

kroppsskole.title: Kroppsskole
kroppsskole.description: An integrated approach to the body and movement.

philosophy_data.subtitle: Through the body and beyond
philosophy_data.b1_p1: Before we think, the body already feels. Before we speak, it already communicates. Before we understand, it already knows.
philosophy_data.b1_p2: Kroppsskole is born from this perception. A school to learn with the body, about the body, through the body. Here, we explore an intelligence that lives in gesture, posture, and breath. It feels, perceives, adjusts, and remembers.
philosophy_data.quote1: "There is a knowledge that the body carries and the mind has not yet translated."
philosophy_data.b2_p1: We invite different facilitators, practices, and knowledge to create experiences that reconnect us with this intelligence. Classes, courses, immersions, and gatherings that explore movement, touch, breath, expression, and presence.
philosophy_data.b2_p2: We welcome diverse bodies, histories, and forms of expression. The more diverse the perspective on the body, the more possibilities we have to understand it.
philosophy_data.quote2: "The body is the foundation. From it, balance, presence, and transformation arise."
philosophy_data.b3_p1: Emotional health and deep well-being mature when we care for the foundation. When we breathe better, walk differently, and feel with more clarity, something shifts in how we are in the world. The change starts in the body and radiates to all that we are.
philosophy_data.b3_p2: Kroppsskole is a space for this process. A place where knowledge and experience meet. Where we can experiment without needing to be right. Where a small change in the body can transform how we live.
philosophy_data.closing: "Through the body, we prepare to go beyond."

corporate.title: A preventive pause
corporate.subtitle: When there is space for pause and care, work gains a different quality.
corporate.hook: Biostretch brings movement and body awareness experiences into companies, creating moments of pause, reconnection, and care, integrating well-being into the work routine in a simple, accessible, and profound way.

body.p1: Through practices that combine movement, stretching, breathwork, and body awareness, employees are invited to step out of autopilot and develop a more conscious relationship with their posture, movements, and overall well-being.
body.pullQuote: An experience designed for each environment.
body.p2: Every company has its own dynamics. Every team faces different physical and mental challenges throughout the workday. Long hours at the computer, repetitive tasks, many hours standing, pressure for results, and an intense routine can generate wear and tear, and accumulated tension that goes unnoticed - until the body sends its signals.
body.p3: That is why Biostretch is always adapted to the characteristics and needs of each organization. The practices are built to offer an inclusive and meaningful experience, respecting different ages, profiles, and fitness levels. It is not just workplace stretching. It is consciousness in movement.

benefits.intro: Biostretch starts from a simple principle: the body was made to move. By bringing more attention to how we position ourselves, breathe, and move, the practice creates opportunities to develop greater body awareness and incorporate self-care habits that last beyond the workshop.

workshops_section.p1: Biostretch workshops are designed to provide experiences that go beyond a simple break in the routine. They are moments of reconnection with the body, with the breath, and with the present.
workshops_section.p2: Each session creates a space to slow down, move with more awareness, and renew energy to continue the day with more presence and balance.
workshops_section.p3: Experiences can be delivered as part of quality of life programs, internal weeks, corporate events, team gatherings, and other well-being initiatives.

corporate.closing: Companies are made of people. When there is space for care, for pause, and for balance, better conditions are created for healthier relationships, more present teams, and a truly sustainable work environment.

individual.title: Biostretch Individual Sessions
individual.subtitle: A personalized approach, tailored to your needs.
individual.hook: Biostretch individual sessions are an option for those who wish to deepen their body work in a personalized way, dedicating more attention to specific needs, perceptions and movement patterns.

body.p1: While workshops provide a collective experience of exploration and awareness through movement, the individual session allows a more attentive and targeted approach to what is particularly relevant to you.
body.pullQuote: A space to perceive and explore.
body.p2: In a safe and welcoming environment, movements are guided by verbal suggestions and gentle touches, inviting you to perceive the body and the sensations that arise during movement. The sequences are performed slowly and gently, promoting relaxation and a more refined perception of how the body moves and organizes itself.
body.p3: From this attention, new perceptions about habits and body patterns can emerge, opening new possibilities for moving with more comfort and efficiency.

focused.p1: The individual session allows you to deepen specific aspects, such as tension, posture, mobility, flexibility, balance, coordination or movement patterns. Each session is adapted to the characteristics and needs of each person, respecting their rhythm and their moment.
focused.p2: More than simply stretching or moving the body, Biostretch proposes an investigation through movement, developing an awareness that can be carried into daily activities.

deepening.kicker: FOR THOSE WHO WANT TO GO DEEPER
deepening.p1: If you have participated in a workshop and wish to explore some aspect of the work more deeply, or if you are looking for a more focused approach to a specific need, the individual session can be an excellent choice.
deepening.p2: Give your body time and attention to discover new possibilities of movement.

individual.closing: Give your body time and attention to discover new possibilities of movement.

regular_classes.title: Regular Classes
regular_classes.subtitle: The value of ongoing work.
regular_classes.hook: A single Biostretch class can open many doors.

block1.p1: A single encounter can bring an insight, a new sensation, an unexpected space of relief, or a perception of the body that was not there before. Sometimes, a single experience is enough for something to begin to shift.
block1.p2: But deep transformation rarely happens all at once. The body needs time to assimilate, experiment, reorganize, and integrate what we experience.

regular_classes.pullQuote1: It is in regularity that the body begins to learn.

block2.p1: This is why Biostretch is not conceived as an isolated class, but as an ongoing process of investigation.
block2.p2: With each session, we return to the body with a little more awareness. We revisit movements, sensations, and patterns. We discover new possibilities and begin, step by step, to recognize what previously went unnoticed.
block2.p3: It is not about doing more, nor forcing a change. It is about creating space for it to happen.
block2.p4: Over time, what seemed like merely a subtle sensation in a first class begins to become familiar. What was difficult to perceive becomes clearer. Movement gains new possibilities, breathing finds more room, and the body begins to respond in a different way.

regular_classes.pullQuote2: A single class can awaken. Continuity allows deepening.

block3.p1: Each session is part of a conversation that the body builds with itself.
block3.p2: And perhaps that is where the true power of Biostretch lies: not in an overnight transformation, but in the small shifts that, repeated and integrated over time, transform how we inhabit our own body.

regular_classes.closing:
Because the body does not only need stimulation.
It needs time to learn.

cv.title: Safia
cv.subtitle: Artistic Director & Creator
paragraphs: Dance entered my life through medical advice. At seven, classical ballet was recommended to correct my foot posture. The initial obligation soon became a fascination. The discipline of the barre and the enthusiasm of master João Luiz Rolla marked the beginning of a journey guided by movement.

Technical rigor took me abroad early on. In 1988, I was awarded a scholarship to the Kiev State Classical Ballet School, immersing myself for two years in the Vaganova method in the former Soviet Union. In Cuba, I performed with the Ballet de Camaguey and the National Ballet, where technical precision lived alongside artists from diverse disciplines.

The urge to transcend the codified forms of ballet led me toward contemporary dance with Companhia Terpsí. Later, a grant in New York opened the door to study Release Technique at the Trisha Brown Company and Movement Research. It was my first encounter with Somatic Education, realizing that movement could emerge from skeletal alignment and listening, sparing unnecessary effort.

This exploration broadened across several fields. I worked backstage as an assistant choreographer at Teatro Castro Alves in Bahia. I earned a degree in Literature from UFRGS, deepening my connection with language. I became a certified Gyrotonic trainer and an educator through Teatro Escola Brincante. I worked on various social projects. In 2007, I co-founded Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, taking on its artistic direction.

Beginning in 2011, daily meditation practice redefined my relationship with the body. The focus shifted from external form to the quality of presence. Conscious breathing and silence became components of movement itself. From this convergence of dance, somatic education, and meditation, Biostretch and Be The Dance emerged.

Currently living in Norway, I act as an artistic bridge with Brazil. From this crossing, Dance2Dance was born, a central project that synthesizes decades of bodily research, pedagogical experience, and investigation into the relationship between technique, presence, and expression. Based in Norway, the initiative is a space for meeting and transformation, dedicated both to dancers and artists as well as anyone seeking to deepen their relationship with their own body.

btd_corporate.title: Human connections and collective vitality
btd_corporate.subtitle: When an organization offers its professionals moments of spontaneity and ease, mutual trust transforms workplace collaboration.
btd_corporate.hook: Daily work routines demand continuous focus on operational targets. Taking the team out of that functional environment into an artistic shared experience reveals the human dimension of each person, solidifying group cohesion in an enduring way.

body.p1: Fostering relaxation, ease, and joy in a corporate setting reflects leadership that genuinely values people. Dance is part of our shared human heritage. Across cultures and eras, moving together awakens personal fulfillment, restores individual vitality, and strengthens the bonds of the tribe.
body.pullQuote: The shared experience of movement brings people together with authenticity.
body.p2: Engaging in a shared activity within an atmosphere of openness and equality enables colleagues to discover new common ground. Movement builds direct bridges of warmth and mutual respect. Professionals who previously interacted only around operational tasks begin to perceive one another as whole individuals, establishing closer, candid, and lasting bonds.
body.p3: Providing this space for personal fulfillment reinforces the perception of authentic organizational care. Investing in dedicated time to unwind demonstrates a company commitment to the comprehensive health of its teams. The outcome is a cohesive, engaged group conscious of the value of each member.

items.label: Shared lightness

items.label: Authentic connection
items.desc: Genuine rapport among colleagues across departments and organizational levels.

items.label: Spontaneous communication
items.desc: Encouraging candid dialogue within a safe, welcoming environment of attentive listening.

items.label: Mutual trust
items.desc: Gaining deeper appreciation for the strengths and sensitivity of every colleague.

items.label: Team cohesion
items.desc: Strengthening unity and a shared sense of organizational belonging.

items.label: Valuing people
items.desc: Tangible proof of the company commitment to human care.

items.label: Relational harmony

workshops_section.p1: The premier corporate format of Be the Dance is structured as a dedicated weekend retreat focused on relaxation and shared experience. Stepping away from daily operational demands creates the ideal setting for genuine reconnection.
workshops_section.p2: The program guides professionals through world music, playful synchronization exercises, and celebratory group movement. Sensitive facilitation allows every participant to engage according to their own comfort, ensuring a welcoming experience for all.
workshops_section.p3: Every detail of the gathering is carefully curated so your team can simply immerse themselves. Let the musical richness, guided movement, and natural camaraderie do the rest.

btd_corporate.closing: Organizations thrive when their people connect on a deeply human level. By offering moments of joy, relaxation, and genuine togetherness, a company honors its present and secures its future.

btd_ung.seoTitle: Be the Dance Ung | The Formation
btd_ung.seoDesc: An artistic dimension of belonging, mastery, and continuous development.
btd_ung.title: Be the Dance Ung.
btd_ung.subtitle: Low-threshold access, mastery, and belonging in Tøyen and Grønland.
btd_ung.hook: Forming an individual requires more than just occupying their time. It involves providing tools of excellence that develop both physical mastery and emotional balance. At Be the Dance Ung, the rigorous technique of ballet and contemporary dance meets the depth of authentic expression, creating a continuous platform that transcends the studio and impacts lives.

body.p1: Providing access to culture is only the first step. True social impact occurs when we deliver excellence. By designing a curriculum that integrates regular foundational classes with immersions focused on individual expression, we build a safe space where youth discover that discipline is not an imposition, but the pathway to their own autonomy.
body.pullQuote: Artistic excellence is the most powerful tool to sculpt confidence.
body.p2: The project is structured to welcome and challenge. The technical foundation, built through classical ballet and contemporary dance, develops mental focus, posture, and spatial awareness. Simultaneously, the Be the Dance awareness methodology works on the youth’s internal state, encouraging them to embrace their uniqueness and express themselves without constraints.
body.p3: The result is an organic journey of mastery. A young person entering an open class can follow a continuous path, culminating in advanced levels and performances—a true qualification platform that opens doors to artistic development under the attentive mentorship of Safia and guest artists.

program_section.intro: The Be the Dance Ung curriculum is built on three complementary fronts, combining the rigor of formal techniques with the development of self-confidence:

list.label: Classical Ballet
list.desc: Developing discipline, body lines, and motor coordination through classical structuring.

list.label: Contemporary Dance
list.desc: Exploring weight, floorwork, and free movement dynamics to stimulate physical expressiveness.

list.label: Body Awareness
list.desc: Intelligent understanding of one’s own mechanics, preventing injuries and building a solid athletic base.

list.label: Unshakable Self-Confidence
list.desc: Practices designed to silence internal and external judgment, allowing true essence to emerge.

list.label: Unique Expression
list.desc: Youth are guided to find their own voice in movement, understanding that their uniqueness is their greatest asset.

list.label: Focus and Presence
list.desc: Mindfulness exercises that anchor the practitioner in the present moment, combating digital distraction.

list.label: Be the Dance Pro
list.desc: The advanced stage designed to catapult young talents and prepare them for real challenges.

list.label: Continuous Mentorship
list.desc: Individualized guidance that transforms raw potential into unquestionable technical capability.

list.label: Stage Excellence
list.desc: The immersive experience of creating, rehearsing, and performing, consolidating identity as an artist and citizen.

impact_section.intro: Our approach translates social transformation goals into practical actions, ensuring profound and structural results in the community:

items.title: Inclusion & Access
items.desc: We do not just offer free entry; we break down cultural and financial barriers. By providing 100% scholarships to local residents, we create a low-threshold space where any youth from Tøyen or Grønland receives the exact same standard of excellence as an elite academy, promoting real inclusion.

items.title: Mastery & Resilience
items.desc: Dance demands rigor and consistency. By mastering complex movements and overcoming their own physical limitations, youth build an unshakable sense of mastery. This experience of continuous mastery in the studio translates into resilience to face academic and social adversities in everyday life.

items.title: Absolute Belonging
items.desc: In an era of digital isolation and social fragmentation, the studio becomes a physical safe haven. Youth become part of a community united by a common language of respect and art. This deep bond with the group and the space creates strong roots, pulling them away from marginalization and consolidating their belonging.

btd_ung.mentorText: Under Safia’s vision, youth receive more than technical instructions; they inherit decades of international dance research. The experience gained on global stages is translated into a sensitive, rigorous mentorship deeply dedicated to awakening each student’s autonomy and leadership.
btd_ung.closing:
Excellence is not a privilege.
It is the result of belonging.

cta.title: Shall we transform the next generation together?
cta.text: Be the Dance Ung seeks continuous partnerships. Schedule a conversation to understand how our methodology aligns with your institution’s long-term goals.

btd_kvinne.seoTitle: Dance2Dance Kvinne | Social Impact for Women
btd_kvinne.seoDesc: A project for women in Tøyen and Grønland, integrating the body awareness of Biostretch and the joy of Be The Dance.
btd_kvinne.title:
Dance2Dance
Kvinne.
btd_kvinne.subtitle: A space for connection and well-being, integrating body awareness and the joy of movement.
btd_kvinne.hook: Deep listening to the body creates space for authentic presence, where every woman rediscovers her own vitality.

body.p1: Dance2Dance Kvinne offers a safe environment where the body ceases to be an instrument of demand and becomes a compass for self-knowledge. By welcoming women into a space free of external expectations, we facilitate a smooth transition between daily rush and reconnecting with one's own essence.
body.pullQuote: When movement flows without judgment, self-esteem blossoms and genuine connections are formed.
body.p2: The project integrates the sensitive listening of Biostretch with the liberating celebration of Be The Dance. Through conscious breathing and the exploration of personal rhythm, each participant accesses a state of presence and bliss. Continuous practice dissolves accumulated tension and restores physical and emotional autonomy.
body.p3: By prioritizing female personal care, we build stronger social foundations. The project provides full scholarships for residents of Tøyen and Grønland, while remaining open to women from across the city. This diversity enriches the mutual support network, transforming participants into multiplying agents of integrative health in their families and neighborhoods.

program_section.intro: We intertwine somatic education and dance as tools for reconnection and gathering.

list.label: Bodily Intelligence
list.desc: An experience of reconnecting with the inherent intelligence within each of us. In this listening, paths open to more health and presence.

list.label: Meditation in Movement
list.desc: A moment to focus attention on the present, abandon what we have learned about how the body should function, and relax.

list.label: Deconstructing Effort
list.desc: An invitation to slow down, breathe, and release what no longer needs to be carried.

list.label: The Dance Within
list.desc: Sequences of movements designed to lead to unexplored territories. Accessing the ancestral dance that is already in our genes. The spontaneous gesture.

list.label: The Body as a Passage
list.desc: A territory of discovery to find a form of expression that is unique, personal, and genuine.

list.label: The Joy of Gathering
list.desc: Dance that steps out of isolation to bring people together, awaken joy, and create connections.

list.label: Exclusive Refuge
list.desc: A safe environment where social and cultural pressure is left outside, prioritizing personal care.

list.label: Support Network
list.desc: Interaction brings women from different backgrounds together and builds deep mutual support.

list.label: Integration Without Borders
list.desc: The language of the body dissolves barriers, creating an ecosystem of belonging and empathy.

impact_section.intro: Our approach translates social transformation goals into practical actions, ensuring deep and structural results in the community.

items.title: Integrative Health and Autonomy
items.desc: Integrating somatic practices directly reduces chronic stress. This process returns ownership of their own bodies to women, reflecting in resilience and mental clarity.

items.title: Social Cohesion and Diversity
items.desc: The universal language of dance dissolves linguistic barriers. We create a space of belonging where women from different backgrounds build authentic ties.

items.title: Structural Multiplier Effect
items.desc: Female well-being is the foundation of family health. An empowered woman radiates this stability to her children and surroundings, generating a sustainable cycle of impact.

btd_kvinne.mentorText: Safia unites decades of research in dance and meditation to lead this space. More than technique, she provides a safe environment where each woman is guided to discover her own movement and recover the pleasure of inhabiting her own body.
btd_kvinne.closing:
To transform a woman's reality
is to transform the core of an entire community.

cta.text: Support Dance2Dance Kvinne and associate your brand with female empowerment and integrative health in Oslo.
